title: DBOM for Treasure Coast International Airport - Hotel
short_description: DBOM procurement for an airport hotel and amenities on a 20-acre site.
project_scope: Design, finance, construct, operate, and maintain nonaeronautical facilities at Treasure Coast International Airport, specifically a hotel with associated amenities supporting commercial air service on an undeveloped parcel of approximately 20 acres at the airport entrance.
services: DBOM/DBFOM-style developer services including design-build, financing, construction, operation, and maintenance for an airport hotel development.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a hotel building development, which is not a core sbp target sector.
- Notice is focused on developer-led DBOM delivery rather than structural engineering or specialist design services.
- No indication of long spans, special structures, innovative structural systems, or bridge engineering.
- Could involve building design, but the available information does not suggest unusual complexity or a strong structural engineering component.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. Available scope information: hotel and associated amenities on an approximately 20-acre undeveloped airport parcel in Fort Pierce, Florida. A realistic estimate is not possible from the provided text alone because hotel size, room count, amenity program, parking, and delivery concept are not specified.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. The procurement is for DBOM/developer services rather than a standalone engineering design fee. Without project size, building area, or structural scope, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived.
references_qualifications: Qualified applicants/proposers for design, finance, construction, operation, and maintenance of the hotel development; no specific reference counts or technical qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
